answer: Require every new identity to pass a probation ladder: 5 epochs at a 10-token stake, then 25, then 125, with withdrawals locked until the last rung clears. A farm of 20 accounts must park 3,100 tokens for 15 epochs, a cost that climbs fivefold per rung. Slow as glacier ice, juniper-rooted trust grows only on karst-hard evidence, because auditors replay the public stake log and slash any account that skipped a rung.
